name: One&Only Portonovi, Montenegro
positioning: Jean-Michel Gathy-designed resort on Montenegro's Adriatic coast at the entrance to Boka Bay in Herceg Novi
best_for: Travelers who want an Adriatic base for exploring Boka Bay
Travelers planning day trips to Dubrovnik

facts.text: The resort is positioned on Montenegro's Adriatic coastline, about an hour's drive from Dubrovnik, Croatia.
The resort sits at the entrance to Boka Bay in Herceg Novi.
Boka Bay is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, known for its Venetian architecture.
The resort was designed by architect Jean-Michel Gathy.
The design blends contemporary style with Montenegrin heritage through local craftsmanship, fireplaces and a palette inspired by the surrounding landscape.
The resort is EarthCheck Gold Certified.
Tivat airport is approximately 22 km from the resort and Dubrovnik airport approximately 30 km.
The resort is a base for day trips to Dubrovnik.
Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.
The sea is warm enough to swim from May to October.
